queries.sql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT UserID, RefererCategoryID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID, RefererCategoryID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31'), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, RefererCategoryID AS first_category FROM ordered WHERE rn = 1), activity AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS total_hits FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_category AS first_category, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(a.active_days) AS avg_active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS return_rate FROM first_touch f JOIN activity a ON f.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY f.first_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY users DESC, first_category LIMIT 25
queries.description: Attributes each user to the referer category of their very first hit and compares how often each first-touch category produces returning users.

queries.sql: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 100), rd AS (SELECT RegionID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY RegionID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) SELECT RegionID, d, hits, region_avg, CAST(hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / region_avg AS spike_ratio FROM (SELECT r.RegionID, r.d, r.hits, (SELECT AVG(CAST(r2.hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM rd r2 WHERE r2.RegionID = r.RegionID) AS region_avg FROM rd r) x WHERE hits > region_avg ORDER BY spike_ratio DESC, RegionID, d LIMIT 30
queries.description: Among the 100 busiest regions, finds the region-days whose traffic most exceeds that region's own average daily volume.

queries.sql: WITH early AS (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY IPNetworkID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT IPNetworkID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-29') SELECT h.IPNetworkID, COUNT(*) AS early_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS early_users, COUNT(DISTINCT h.EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND h.IPNetworkID IN (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM early) GROUP BY h.IPNetworkID ORDER BY early_hits DESC, h.IPNetworkID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Lists the busiest IP networks of the first July week that went completely silent during the last days of the month.

queries.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits), firsts AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID AS first_source FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), act AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_source AS source_id, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(a.active_days), 3) AS avg_active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users FROM firsts f JOIN act a ON f.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY f.first_source ORDER BY users DESC, source_id
queries.description: First-touch attribution: groups users by the traffic source of their very first hit and reports their average number of active days and how many returned on a second day.

queries.sql: SELECT kind, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT 'self_referred' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND h.Referer <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits p WHERE p.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND p.UserID = h.UserID AND p.URLHash = h.RefererHash) UNION ALL SELECT 'outside_entry' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND h.Referer <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits p WHERE p.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND p.UserID = h.UserID AND p.URLHash = h.RefererHash)) t ORDER BY kind
queries.description: On July 15, splits referred hits into those whose referer page the same user also visited that day and those arriving from pages never seen.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) x) ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Lists the days of July whose hit volume exceeds the average daily hit volume.

queries.sql: SELECT campaign_prefix, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMTerm) AS distinct_terms, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(UTMCampaign)) AS avg_campaign_chars FROM (SELECT UserID, UTMTerm, UTMCampaign, CASE WHEN UTMCampaign = '' THEN '(none)' ELSE SUBSTRING(UTMCampaign, 1, 4) END AS campaign_prefix FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0) c GROUP BY campaign_prefix HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 2 ORDER BY users DESC, campaign_prefix LIMIT 20
queries.description: Groups non-refresh hits by the first four characters of the UTM campaign and reports reach, term diversity and average campaign-name length for prefixes seen by at least two users.

queries.sql: SELECT week_start_day, URLRegionID, users, rnk FROM (SELECT week_start_day, URLRegionID, users, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY week_start_day ORDER BY users DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('week', EventDate)) AS week_start_day, URLRegionID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('week', EventDate)), URLRegionID) a) t WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY week_start_day, rnk, URLRegionID LIMIT 100
queries.description: Top three URL regions by distinct users within each calendar week.

queries.sql: WITH burners AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08'), per_user AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM burners) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN hits_cnt = 1 THEN '1' WHEN hits_cnt <= 10 THEN '2-10' WHEN hits_cnt <= 100 THEN '11-100' ELSE '101+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_total FROM per_user GROUP BY CASE WHEN hits_cnt = 1 THEN '1' WHEN hits_cnt <= 10 THEN '2-10' WHEN hits_cnt <= 100 THEN '11-100' ELSE '101+' END ORDER BY MIN(hits_cnt), bucket
queries.description: Histograms the activity of 'burner' users seen only in the first week of July and never again.

queries.sql: WITH reg AS (SELECT RegionID AS region, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000), soc AS (SELECT RegionID AS s_region, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS social_users FROM hits WHERE SocialSourceNetworkID <> 0 GROUP BY RegionID) SELECT r.region AS region_id, r.n_hits AS total_hits, r.users AS total_users FROM reg r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc s WHERE s.s_region = r.region AND s.social_users >= 5) ORDER BY total_hits DESC, region_id LIMIT 25
queries.description: Large regions (10000+ hits) that also have at least five users arriving from social networks, ordered by traffic.

queries.sql: WITH lang AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang_code, COUNT(*) AS total_hits FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY total_hits DESC, lang_code LIMIT 10), daily AS (SELECT h.BrowserLanguage AS lang_code, h.EventDate AS day_date, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits h INNER JOIN lang l ON h.BrowserLanguage = l.lang_code GROUP BY h.BrowserLanguage, h.EventDate), ranked AS (SELECT lang_code, day_date, day_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lang_code ORDER BY day_hits, day_date) AS rn_low, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lang_code) AS active_days, MAX(day_hits) OVER (PARTITION BY lang_code) AS peak_day_hits FROM daily) SELECT r.lang_code, r.day_date AS quietest_day, r.day_hits AS quietest_hits, r.peak_day_hits, r.active_days, l.total_hits FROM ranked r INNER JOIN lang l ON r.lang_code = l.lang_code WHERE r.rn_low = 1 ORDER BY l.total_hits DESC, r.lang_code
queries.description: For the ten largest browser languages, finds the quietest day and compares it with the peak day and the number of active days.

queries.sql: SELECT MobilePhoneModel, CHAR_LENGTH(MobilePhoneModel) AS model_len FROM (SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' AND EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel EXCEPT SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel) x ORDER BY model_len, MobilePhoneModel LIMIT 50
queries.description: Lists phone models seen in the first half of July that never appear in the second half.

queries.sql: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), fs AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM ud GROUP BY UserID) SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) AS cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.UserID) AS cohort_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM ud.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS returned_week1, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM ud.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT fs.UserID) AS retention_week1 FROM fs JOIN ud ON fs.UserID = ud.UserID WHERE fs.first_day <= '2013-07-24' GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) ORDER BY cohort_day
queries.description: Daily acquisition cohorts with the number and share of users who came back within the following seven days.

queries.sql: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RefererRegionID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY RefererRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RefererRegionID LIMIT 5), phrase_stats AS (SELECT RefererRegionID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND RefererRegionID IN (SELECT RefererRegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY RefererRegionID, SearchPhrase), ranked AS (SELECT RefererRegionID, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererRegionID ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM phrase_stats) SELECT RefererRegionID, rn, SearchPhrase, users FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY RefererRegionID, rn
queries.description: For the five referring regions with the most search traffic, the three search phrases reaching the most users in each.

queries.sql: WITH w1 AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID), w4 AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31' GROUP BY UserID), both_weeks AS (SELECT UserID FROM w1 INTERSECT SELECT UserID FROM w4) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w1) AS week1_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_weeks) AS retained_users, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_weeks) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w1), 0) AS retention_rate ORDER BY week1_users
queries.description: Measures how many users active in the first week of July came back in the last ten days of the month, and the resulting retention rate.

queries.sql: WITH rd AS (SELECT RegionID AS region, EventDate AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 20) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.dt) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS spiking_regions, SUM(o.dau) AS users_in_spikes FROM rd o WHERE o.dau > 1.5 * (SELECT AVG(i.dau) FROM rd i WHERE i.region = o.region) GROUP BY o.dt ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: For each day, how many regions had a user spike of more than 1.5 times their own average daily users.

queries.sql: SELECT start_hour, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, hr AS start_hour, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) = 1 OR secs - LAG(secs) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start FROM (SELECT UserID, EventTime, WatchID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS secs FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15') b) s WHERE is_start = 1 GROUP BY start_hour ORDER BY start_hour
queries.description: Number of sessions (30-minute inactivity rule) starting in each hour of July 15.

queries.sql: WITH ud AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits), fu AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(d) AS first_d FROM ud GROUP BY UserID), cm AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(f.first_d - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS cohort_week, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(u.d - f.first_d AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS weeks_since_first, COUNT(DISTINCT u.UserID) AS users FROM ud u JOIN fu f ON u.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(f.first_d - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER), CAST(FLOOR(CAST(u.d - f.first_d AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER)) SELECT cohort_week, weeks_since_first, users, CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(MAX(users) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_week), 0) AS retention FROM cm ORDER BY cohort_week, weeks_since_first
queries.description: Weekly cohort retention matrix: users grouped by the week of first activity and counted in each subsequent week, with retention relative to the cohort size.

queries.sql: WITH cv AS (SELECT DISTINCT CodeVersion, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits) SELECT a.d, COUNT(*) AS new_versions FROM cv a WHERE a.d > 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cv b WHERE b.CodeVersion = a.CodeVersion AND b.d = a.d - 1) GROUP BY a.d ORDER BY a.d
queries.description: Counts, per day, code versions that appear on that day but were absent the previous day, i.e. fresh rollouts or resurrections.

queries.sql: SELECT scheme, has_query, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(URL)) AS avg_url_chars, SUM(CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%.html%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS html_hits FROM (SELECT UserID, URL, CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' WHEN URL = '' THEN 'empty' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_query FROM hits) u GROUP BY scheme, has_query ORDER BY scheme, has_query
queries.description: Splits traffic by URL scheme and by the presence of a query string, reporting volume, users, average URL length in characters and the number of .html pages.

queries.sql: WITH oh AS (SELECT OS, ResolutionHeight AS height, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE ResolutionHeight > 0 AND OS IN (SELECT OS FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS LIMIT 5) GROUP BY OS, ResolutionHeight), r AS (SELECT OS AS os_id, height, users, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY users DESC) AS dr FROM oh) SELECT os_id, height, users, dr AS height_rank FROM r WHERE dr <= 3 ORDER BY os_id, height_rank, height
queries.description: For the five busiest operating systems, the screen heights holding the top three dense ranks by distinct users.

queries.sql: SELECT g.Age, g.hits_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits b WHERE b.Age = g.Age AND b.HistoryLength = 0) AS zero_history_hits FROM (SELECT Age, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY Age) g ORDER BY g.Age
queries.description: For each age, the total hits and, through a correlated subquery, the hits made from a tab with empty history.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteIP) AS ips FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteIP) >= 5), overall AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientTimeZone) AS tz_count FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM daily) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT d.UserID, MAX(d.ips) AS max_daily_ips, COUNT(*) AS hopping_days, o.active_days, o.tz_count FROM daily d JOIN overall o ON d.UserID = o.UserID GROUP BY d.UserID, o.active_days, o.tz_count ORDER BY max_daily_ips DESC, hopping_days DESC, d.UserID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Identifies IP-hopping users who use five or more remote IPs in a single day, together with how many days they are active and how many time zones they report.

queries.sql: SELECT d, hr, hits, avg_fetch FROM (SELECT EventDate AS d, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY AVG(FetchTiming) DESC, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS rn FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY d
queries.description: For each day, picks the hour with the worst average fetch timing among hours with at least 100 hits.

queries.sql: WITH flip AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 1), us AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS days_active, COUNT(*) AS n_hits FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM flip) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT days_active, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(n_hits), 2) AS avg_hits FROM us GROUP BY days_active ORDER BY days_active
queries.description: Users seen both with and without JavaScript enabled, distributed by their number of active days with average hits per user.

queries.sql: SELECT charset_family, age_band, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN PageCharset = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN LOWER(PageCharset) LIKE '%utf%' THEN 'utf' WHEN LOWER(PageCharset) LIKE '%1251%' OR LOWER(PageCharset) LIKE '%cp%' THEN 'cyrillic_legacy' ELSE 'other' END AS charset_family, CASE WHEN Age = 0 THEN 'unknown' WHEN Age < 18 THEN 'minor' WHEN Age < 35 THEN 'young' ELSE 'older' END AS age_band FROM hits) t GROUP BY charset_family, age_band ORDER BY charset_family, age_band
queries.description: Cross-tabulates page charset families with age bands to see whether odd charsets correlate with users of unknown age.

queries.sql: SELECT h.Age, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS early_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate < '2013-07-08' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits l WHERE l.UserID = h.UserID AND l.EventDate >= '2013-07-25') GROUP BY h.Age ORDER BY h.Age
queries.description: Counts, per age group, users active in the first week of July who never returned during the last week.

queries.sql: WITH both_langs AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 AND BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 INTERSECT SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE ResolutionWidth >= 1600 AND BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) SELECT h.BrowserLanguage, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits h WHERE h.BrowserLanguage IN (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM both_langs) GROUP BY h.BrowserLanguage ORDER BY hit_count DESC, h.BrowserLanguage LIMIT 30
queries.description: Finds browser languages that are well represented both on mobile devices and on very wide screens and reports their total traffic.

queries.sql: SELECT day_of_month, peak_hour, peak_hits, day_hits, CAST(peak_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(day_hits, 0) AS peak_share FROM (SELECT day_of_month, hour_of_day AS peak_hour, hit_count AS peak_hits, SUM(hit_count) OVER (PARTITION BY day_of_month) AS day_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day_of_month ORDER BY hit_count DESC, hour_of_day) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) AS day_of_month, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) h) r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Finds the peak ('solstice') hour of each day and the share of that day's non-refresh traffic falling into it.

queries.sql: WITH cvd AS (SELECT CodeVersion, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY CodeVersion, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)), top_cv AS (SELECT CodeVersion, SUM(hits) AS total_hits FROM cvd GROUP BY CodeVersion ORDER BY total_hits DESC, CodeVersion LIMIT 15) SELECT t.CodeVersion, t.total_hits, x.d AS first_day, x.hits AS first_day_hits FROM top_cv t JOIN cvd x ON x.CodeVersion = t.CodeVersion WHERE x.d = (SELECT MIN(y.d) FROM cvd y WHERE y.CodeVersion = x.CodeVersion) ORDER BY t.total_hits DESC, t.CodeVersion
queries.description: For the 15 most-used code versions, shows the first day each was observed and how much traffic it carried on that day.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN IsDownload = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downloads, SUM(CASE WHEN IsLink = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
queries.description: Hourly profile of hits, downloads, link clicks and users on the busiest day of the month.

queries.sql: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 10), mm AS (SELECT RegionID AS region, MobilePhoneModel AS model, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' AND RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY RegionID, MobilePhoneModel), ranked AS (SELECT region, model, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY users DESC, model) AS rn FROM mm) SELECT region AS region_id, model AS phone_model, users, rn AS model_rank FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY region_id, model_rank
queries.description: In the ten regions with the most mobile-model users, the three most popular phone models by distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID), core AS (SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM s ORDER BY hits DESC, RegionID LIMIT 30) a INTERSECT SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM s ORDER BY users DESC, RegionID LIMIT 30) b INTERSECT SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM s ORDER BY nets DESC, RegionID LIMIT 30) c) SELECT s.RegionID, s.hits, s.users, s.nets, CAST(s.hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(s.users, 0) AS hits_per_user FROM s JOIN core ON s.RegionID = core.RegionID ORDER BY s.hits DESC, s.RegionID
queries.description: Finds regions that rank in the top 30 simultaneously by hits, by distinct users and by distinct IP networks, with their hits-per-user intensity.

queries.sql: SELECT utm_shape, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, MIN(CHAR_LENGTH(UTMSource)) AS min_len, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(UTMSource)) AS max_len FROM (SELECT UserID, UTMSource, CASE WHEN UTMSource <> TRIM(UTMSource) THEN 'padded' WHEN UTMSource LIKE '%.%' THEN 'domain_like' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMSource) <= 3 THEN 'short' ELSE 'plain' END AS utm_shape FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '') t GROUP BY utm_shape ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, utm_shape
queries.description: Classifies non-empty UTM sources by shape (whitespace-padded, domain-like, very short, plain) to surface hand-crafted or scripted campaign tags.

queries.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, EventTime, IsMobile, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) * 86400 + EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS secs FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-14'), marked AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, EventTime, IsMobile, secs, CASE WHEN secs - LAG(secs) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) <= 1800 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_start FROM ev), numbered AS (SELECT UserID, IsMobile, secs, SUM(is_start) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no FROM marked), sessions AS (SELECT UserID, session_no, MAX(IsMobile) AS mobile_flag, COUNT(*) AS depth, MAX(secs) - MIN(secs) AS duration FROM numbered GROUP BY UserID, session_no) SELECT mobile_flag, CASE WHEN duration = 0 THEN 'b0_instant' WHEN duration < 60 THEN 'b1_under_minute' WHEN duration < 600 THEN 'b2_under_10min' WHEN duration < 1800 THEN 'b3_under_30min' ELSE 'b4_long' END AS duration_band, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(depth) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM sessions GROUP BY mobile_flag, duration_band ORDER BY mobile_flag, duration_band
queries.description: Sessionizes the second week of July with a 30-minute gap rule and buckets sessions by duration and mobile flag.

queries.sql: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ConnectTiming > (SELECT AVG(ConnectTiming) FROM hits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_hits, ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2) AS avg_connect FROM hits GROUP BY OS HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, OS LIMIT 15
queries.description: For large operating systems, how many hits had a connect time above the global average.

queries.sql: SELECT OS, MobilePhoneModel, users, rn FROM (SELECT OS, MobilePhoneModel, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, MobilePhoneModel) AS rn FROM (SELECT OS, MobilePhoneModel, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY OS, MobilePhoneModel) a) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: The three phone models with the most distinct users within each operating system.

queries.sql: WITH busy AS (SELECT IPNetworkID, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY hits DESC, IPNetworkID LIMIT 200) SELECT b.IPNetworkID, b.hits FROM busy b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.IPNetworkID = b.IPNetworkID AND h.JavascriptEnable = 0 AND h.IsRefresh = 1) ORDER BY b.hits DESC, b.IPNetworkID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Among the 200 busiest IP networks, lists those that produced refresh hits from clients with JavaScript disabled, a typical scraper fingerprint.

queries.sql: WITH late_only AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16') SELECT h.UserAgent AS ua, h.UserAgentMinor AS ua_minor, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, CAST(MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM h.EventDate)) AS INTEGER) AS first_seen_day FROM hits h JOIN late_only l ON h.UserAgent = l.UserAgent AND h.UserAgentMinor = l.UserAgentMinor WHERE h.EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY h.UserAgent, h.UserAgentMinor ORDER BY users DESC, n_hits DESC, ua, ua_minor LIMIT 30
queries.description: Browser versions that first appeared in the second half of July, with their adoption in users and hits and the day they were first seen.

queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang, UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN EventDate <= '2013-07-15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_first, MAX(CASE WHEN EventDate > '2013-07-15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_second FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage, UserID) SELECT lang, SUM(in_first) AS first_half_users, SUM(in_first * in_second) AS retained_users, CAST(SUM(in_first * in_second) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(in_first), 0) AS retention FROM u GROUP BY lang HAVING SUM(in_first) >= 200 ORDER BY first_half_users DESC, lang LIMIT 20
queries.description: Per browser language, the share of users active in the first half of July who came back in the second half.

queries.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', EventTime) AS minute_ts, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(ConnectTiming) AS connect_sum FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('minute', EventTime)), w AS (SELECT minute_ts, hits_cnt, connect_sum, SUM(connect_sum) OVER (ORDER BY minute_ts ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_connect, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY minute_ts ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_hits FROM m) SELECT minute_ts, hits_cnt, rolling_hits, rolling_connect, CAST(rolling_connect AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(rolling_hits, 0) AS rolling_avg_connect FROM w ORDER BY rolling_connect DESC, minute_ts LIMIT 20
queries.description: On the busiest day, finds the 20 minutes with the highest 5-minute rolling sum of connect timing and shows the rolling average.

queries.sql: SELECT PageCharset, RegionID, hits, avg_rst FROM (SELECT PageCharset, RegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PageCharset ORDER BY AVG(ResponseStartTiming) DESC, RegionID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE PageCharset <> '' GROUP BY PageCharset, RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY PageCharset, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each page charset, shows the three regions with the slowest average response start among regions with at least 500 hits.

queries.sql: SELECT h.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS refresh_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits h WHERE h.IsRefresh = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h2 WHERE h2.UserID = h.UserID AND h2.URLHash = h.URLHash AND h2.IsRefresh = 0) GROUP BY h.TraficSourceID ORDER BY refresh_hits DESC, h.TraficSourceID
queries.description: Counts refresh hits per traffic source where the same user also loaded the same URL without a refresh.

queries.sql: SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(CAST(c AS VARCHAR)) AS digits, COUNT(*) AS versions, MIN(c) AS min_hits, MAX(c) AS max_hits FROM (SELECT CodeVersion, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CodeVersion) t GROUP BY CHAR_LENGTH(CAST(c AS VARCHAR)) ORDER BY digits
queries.description: Buckets code versions by the order of magnitude (digit count) of their hit volume to see how traffic is spread across deployed versions.

queries.sql: WITH mw AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionWidth, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionWidth), tot AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, SUM(c) AS total_c, COUNT(*) AS widths FROM mw GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel), top_m AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, total_c, widths FROM tot ORDER BY total_c DESC, MobilePhoneModel LIMIT 20), ranked AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionWidth, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MobilePhoneModel ORDER BY c DESC, ResolutionWidth) AS rn FROM mw) SELECT t.MobilePhoneModel, t.total_c, t.widths, r.ResolutionWidth AS modal_width, r.c AS modal_hits FROM top_m t INNER JOIN ranked r ON t.MobilePhoneModel = r.MobilePhoneModel WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.total_c DESC, t.MobilePhoneModel
queries.description: For the 20 most frequent phone models, reports the number of distinct screen widths and the most common width.

queries.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY SearchPhrase), b AS (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND IsNotBounce = 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a) AS engaged_phrases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) AS bounced_phrases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM a EXCEPT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM b) x) AS only_engaged, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM a INTERSECT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM b) y) AS both_kinds ORDER BY engaged_phrases
queries.description: Counts search phrases that led to engaged visits, to bounced visits, only to engaged visits, and to both.

queries.sql: WITH top_agents AS (SELECT UserAgent FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 10), agg AS (SELECT UserAgent, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE UserAgent IN (SELECT UserAgent FROM top_agents) AND ResolutionWidth > 0 GROUP BY UserAgent, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight), ranked AS (SELECT UserAgent, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserAgent ORDER BY hit_count DESC, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT UserAgent, rn, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight, hit_count FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY UserAgent, rn
queries.description: For the ten busiest browsers, lists the three most common screen resolutions of each.

queries.sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS fd FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), days AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.fd) AS first_day, COUNT(DISTINCT f.UserID) AS cohort_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM d.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.fd) = 1 THEN d.UserID END) AS back_next_day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM d.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.fd) BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN d.UserID END) AS back_week_two FROM firsts f INNER JOIN days d ON d.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.fd) ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: Daily first-visit cohorts with the number of users who came back the next day and during their second week.

queries.sql: SELECT h.IsMobile, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT h.ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits h WHERE h.JavascriptEnable = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h2 WHERE h2.ClientIP = h.ClientIP AND h2.JavascriptEnable = 1) GROUP BY h.IsMobile ORDER BY h.IsMobile
queries.description: Measures the traffic from client IPs that never sent a single JavaScript-enabled hit, split by mobile flag.

queries.sql: SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS rapid_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT sod) AS distinct_seconds FROM (SELECT UserID, sod, sod - LAG(sod, 1, -100000) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sod) AS gap FROM (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS sod FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15') s) g WHERE gap <= 1 GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY rapid_hits DESC, distinct_seconds, UserID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Finds users on 2013-07-15 with many hits that arrived at most one second after their previous hit, a machine-gun click pattern typical of bots.

queries.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) * 86400 + EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS ts FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-14'), gaps AS (SELECT UserID, ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY ts) AS rn, MAX(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_ts FROM ev), flagged AS (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN rn = 1 OR ts - prev_ts > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session FROM gaps), per_user AS (SELECT UserID, SUM(new_session) AS sessions, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM flagged GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN sessions >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE sessions END AS sessions_bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hit_count) AS total_hits, AVG(hit_count) AS avg_hits_per_user FROM per_user GROUP BY CASE WHEN sessions >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE sessions END ORDER BY sessions_bucket
queries.description: Reconstructs sessions in the second week of July by splitting each user's hits wherever there is a gap of more than 30 minutes, then shows the distribution of users by session count.

queries.sql: SELECT LOWER(BrowserLanguage) || '/' || CAST(UserAgentMajor AS VARCHAR) AS lang_agent, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY LOWER(BrowserLanguage) || '/' || CAST(UserAgentMajor AS VARCHAR) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY hits_cnt, lang_agent LIMIT 40
queries.description: Builds language/browser-version labels and lists the 40 rarest labels that occur at least twice.

queries.sql: SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users, SUM(CASE WHEN last_day - first_day >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_3plus, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN last_day - first_day >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS retention_7d FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS first_day, MAX(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS last_day, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) u WHERE first_day <= 24 GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: Groups users into cohorts by their first day in July and computes, for each cohort, the share still active at least seven days later and the number of users active on three or more days.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT FlashMajor, JavascriptEnable, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY FlashMajor, JavascriptEnable) SELECT s.FlashMajor, s.JavascriptEnable, s.c AS hit_count FROM s WHERE s.c > (SELECT AVG(s2.c) FROM s s2 WHERE s2.JavascriptEnable = s.JavascriptEnable) ORDER BY s.JavascriptEnable, hit_count DESC, s.FlashMajor LIMIT 50
queries.description: Lists Flash versions whose hit count exceeds the average count of all Flash versions with the same JavaScript setting.

queries.sql: SELECT a.RegionID, a.hits AS week1_hits, b.hits AS week4_hits, a.avg_rst AS week1_rst, b.avg_rst AS week4_rst, b.avg_rst - a.avg_rst AS rst_delta FROM (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2013-07-07' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) a JOIN (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-22' AND '2013-07-28' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) b ON a.RegionID = b.RegionID ORDER BY rst_delta DESC, a.RegionID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Ranks regions by how much their average response start timing degraded from the first to the fourth week of July.

queries.sql: SELECT h.SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS searches, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = h.UserID AND d.EventDate = h.EventDate AND d.IsNotBounce = 1) GROUP BY h.SearchEngineID ORDER BY searches DESC, h.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Counts search hits per search engine for users who had a non-bounce hit on the same day.

queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS m FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15'), w AS (SELECT UserID, m, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY m) AS rn, MAX(m) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS pm FROM t), s AS (SELECT UserID, SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 OR m - pm > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM w GROUP BY UserID) SELECT sessions, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hits) AS hits FROM s GROUP BY sessions ORDER BY sessions LIMIT 50
queries.description: Sessionizes one day of traffic with a 30-minute inactivity gap and histograms users by their number of sessions.

queries.sql: SELECT SearchEngineID, day_num, searches, SUM(searches) OVER (PARTITION BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY day_num ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS searches_3d FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_num, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID IN (SELECT SearchEngineID FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SearchEngineID LIMIT 3) GROUP BY SearchEngineID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) t ORDER BY SearchEngineID, day_num
queries.description: Daily search hits and a three-day moving sum for the three busiest search engines.

queries.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 1440 + CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS m FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0), g AS (SELECT UserID, m, LAG(m) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY m, WatchID) AS prev_m, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY m, WatchID) AS rn FROM ev), per_user AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 OR m - prev_m > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions FROM g GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN sessions >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE sessions END AS sessions_bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(n_hits), 2) AS avg_hits_per_user FROM per_user GROUP BY CASE WHEN sessions >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE sessions END ORDER BY sessions_bucket
queries.description: Sessionizes non-refresh hits per user with a 30-minute inactivity gap and shows how many users have 1, 2, ... 10+ sessions along with their average hit count.

queries.sql: SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(URL) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '/', '')) AS slash_count, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(IsNotBounce), 4) AS not_bounce_rate FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY CHAR_LENGTH(URL) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '/', '')) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY slash_count LIMIT 30
queries.description: Engagement rate by URL path depth measured as the number of slashes in the URL.

queries.sql: SELECT h.Age, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits h WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits w WHERE w.UserID = h.UserID AND w.WindowClientHeight BETWEEN 1 AND 199) GROUP BY h.Age ORDER BY h.Age
queries.description: Age distribution of users who at least once browsed with a tiny window under 200 pixels high.

queries.sql: WITH dh AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS dom, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hod, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER), CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER)), r AS (SELECT dom, hod, n_hits, users, SUM(n_hits) OVER (PARTITION BY dom) AS day_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dom ORDER BY users DESC, hod) AS rn FROM dh) SELECT dom AS day_of_month, hod AS peak_hour, users AS peak_users, n_hits AS peak_hits, CAST(n_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(day_hits, 0) AS share_of_day_hits FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: For each day, the hour with the most distinct users, with that hour's hits and its share of the day's hits.

queries.sql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), daily AS (SELECT EventDate, UserID FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, UserID) SELECT d.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS active_users, SUM(CASE WHEN d.EventDate = f.first_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_users FROM daily d JOIN first_seen f ON d.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY d.EventDate ORDER BY d.EventDate
queries.description: Daily active users split into those seen for the first time that day and returning users.

queries.sql: SELECT FLOOR(deep_share * 10) AS decile, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_cnt FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN HistoryLength >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS deep_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) c GROUP BY FLOOR(deep_share * 10) ORDER BY decile
queries.description: Groups counters with at least 100 hits into deciles by their share of deep-history visits (history length of 10 or more).

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes, CAST(SUM(IsRefresh) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS refresh_share FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate HAVING CAST(SUM(IsRefresh) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(SUM(IsRefresh) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Lists the days whose page-refresh share is above the month-wide refresh share, a sign of refresh loops or outages.

queries.sql: SELECT dominant_daypart, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(active_days) AS avg_active_days, AVG(hit_count) AS avg_hits FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) < 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 2 > COUNT(*) THEN 'night' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) >= 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 2 > COUNT(*) THEN 'evening' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 2 > COUNT(*) THEN 'morning' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 2 > COUNT(*) THEN 'afternoon' ELSE 'mixed' END AS dominant_daypart FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) u GROUP BY dominant_daypart ORDER BY dominant_daypart
queries.description: Classifies each user by the part of the day in which more than half of their hits occur and compares loyalty (active days) and depth across these classes.

queries.sql: SELECT h.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS link_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits h WHERE h.IsLink = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = h.UserID AND d.IsDownload = 1) GROUP BY h.TraficSourceID ORDER BY link_hits DESC, h.TraficSourceID
queries.description: Outbound-link hits by traffic source, counted only for users who never triggered a download.

queries.sql: WITH mr AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel AS model, RegionID AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel, RegionID) SELECT o.model AS phone_model, COUNT(*) AS strong_regions, SUM(o.cnt) AS hits_in_strong_regions FROM mr o WHERE o.cnt > (SELECT AVG(i.cnt) FROM mr i WHERE i.model = o.model) GROUP BY o.model HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY strong_regions DESC, hits_in_strong_regions DESC, phone_model LIMIT 20
queries.description: For each mobile phone model, counts the regions where the model's hit volume exceeds that model's own average per-region volume, keeping models with at least three such strong regions.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_of_month, hr AS peak_hour, c AS peak_hits, ROUND(CAST(c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / day_total, 4) AS peak_share FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, c, SUM(c) OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate) AS day_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) a) b WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Finds the peak hour of each day and the share of that day's traffic concentrated in it.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMCampaign = '' THEN 'none' WHEN UTMCampaign LIKE '%-%' THEN 'dashed' WHEN UTMCampaign LIKE '%.%' THEN 'dotted' WHEN UTMCampaign LIKE '% %' THEN 'spaced' ELSE 'plain' END AS campaign_shape, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMCampaign) AS campaigns, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(UTMCampaign)) AS max_len, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged FROM hits GROUP BY campaign_shape ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, campaign_shape
queries.description: Classifies UTM campaign labels by separator shape and reports their volume, variety, maximum length and engagement.

queries.sql: SELECT URLRegionID AS url_region, hits_cnt, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URLRegionID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_hits, CAST(SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URLRegionID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS cumulative_share FROM (SELECT URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY URLRegionID) t ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, url_region LIMIT 20
queries.description: Pareto curve of URL regions: running total and cumulative share of all hits for the top 20 regions.

queries.sql: WITH buyers AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE ParamPrice > 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM buyers) THEN 'priced' ELSE 'unpriced' END AS segment, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(IsNotBounce), 4) AS engage_rate, SUM(IsLink) AS link_hits FROM hits GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment
queries.description: Compares traffic volume, users, engagement and link clicks of users who ever triggered a priced event against all other users.

queries.sql: SELECT weekday_index, CASE WHEN weekday_index >= 5 THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS days_observed, AVG(dau) AS avg_dau, AVG(day_hits) AS avg_day_hits FROM (SELECT EventDate, (CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 7 AS weekday_index, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) AS d GROUP BY weekday_index ORDER BY weekday_index
queries.description: Average daily active users and hits per weekday of July 2013 (0 = Monday), labelled as weekday or weekend.

queries.sql: SELECT next_gap AS gap_days, COUNT(*) AS transitions, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, LEAD(day_num) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY day_num) - day_num AS next_gap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY day_num) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID) AS days_cnt FROM (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS day_num FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) d) g WHERE rn < days_cnt GROUP BY next_gap ORDER BY gap_days
queries.description: Distribution of the number of days between consecutive active days of the same user.

queries.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_ts FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), fa AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_ad_ts FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN fa.first_ad_ts = f.first_ts THEN 'ad_first' WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM fa.first_ad_ts) = EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_ts) THEN 'ad_same_day' ELSE 'ad_later' END AS entry_kind, COUNT(*) AS users FROM f INNER JOIN fa ON f.UserID = fa.UserID GROUP BY entry_kind ORDER BY users DESC, entry_kind
queries.description: For users with any ad hit, classifies whether their first ad hit was their very first hit, happened later the same day, or on a later day.

queries.sql: SELECT RegionID AS region_id, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(Income) AS avg_income FROM hits WHERE Income > 0 GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 50 AND AVG(Income) > (SELECT AVG(Income) FROM hits WHERE Income > 0) ORDER BY avg_income DESC, region_id LIMIT 20
queries.description: Regions with at least 50 users whose average income bracket exceeds the global average.

queries.sql: SELECT TraficSourceID, MobilePhoneModel, users FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, MobilePhoneModel, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY users DESC, MobilePhoneModel) AS rn FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, MobilePhoneModel, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY TraficSourceID, MobilePhoneModel) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY TraficSourceID, rn
queries.description: The three phone models with the most users within each traffic source.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMMedium = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN LOWER(UTMMedium) LIKE '%cpc%' THEN 'cpc_like' WHEN UTMMedium LIKE '%-%' THEN 'hyphenated' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMMedium) <= 4 THEN 'short' ELSE 'other' END AS medium_shape, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMMedium) AS variants, SUM(HasGCLID) AS gclid_hits FROM hits GROUP BY medium_shape ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, medium_shape
queries.description: Classifies UTM medium values by their textual shape and counts hits, distinct variants and GCLID hits in each class.

queries.sql: WITH user_days AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)), shifted AS (SELECT UserID, d + 1 AS next_d, d AS base_d FROM user_days), retained AS (SELECT s.base_d AS d, COUNT(*) AS retained_users FROM shifted s JOIN user_days u ON s.UserID = u.UserID AND s.next_d = u.d GROUP BY s.base_d), totals AS (SELECT d, COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM user_days GROUP BY d) SELECT t.d AS day_of_month, t.active_users AS active_users, r.retained_users AS retained_users, CAST(r.retained_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t.active_users, 0) AS next_day_retention FROM totals t JOIN retained r ON t.d = r.d ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Computes the next-day retention for each day of July by self-joining the set of user-days with itself shifted by one day.

queries.sql: SELECT CodeVersion, hits_cnt, zero_timing, zero_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY zero_share DESC) AS share_rank FROM (SELECT CodeVersion, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN SendTiming = 0 AND ConnectTiming = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_timing, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SendTiming = 0 AND ConnectTiming = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS zero_share FROM hits GROUP BY CodeVersion HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000) t ORDER BY share_rank, CodeVersion LIMIT 20
queries.description: Ranks counter code versions by the share of hits with zero send and connect timings, a sign of synthetic beacons that never hit the network.

queries.sql: SELECT day_of_month, users, prev_users, CAST(users AS BIGINT) - CAST(prev_users AS BIGINT) AS delta_users FROM (SELECT day_of_month, users, MAX(users) OVER (ORDER BY day_of_month ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day_of_month) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_of_month, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) a) d WHERE rn > 1 ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Shows the day-over-day change in distinct non-refresh users, using a one-row preceding window frame to fetch the previous day.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS adv_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT AdvEngineID) AS engines FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Days on which advertising-engine traffic exceeded the average daily advertising traffic of the month.

queries.sql: SELECT RefererCategoryID, rn AS rank_in_category, URLRegionID, users FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID, URLRegionID, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererCategoryID ORDER BY users DESC, URLRegionID) AS rn FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID, URLRegionID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY RefererCategoryID, URLRegionID) a) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY RefererCategoryID, rank_in_category LIMIT 100
queries.description: For every referer category, finds the three URL regions that attract the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang, COUNT(*) AS c1 FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2013-07-07' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage), b AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang, COUNT(*) AS c2 FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-25' AND '2013-07-31' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.c1, 0) = 0 THEN b.lang ELSE a.lang END AS lang_key, COALESCE(a.c1, 0) AS early_hits, COALESCE(b.c2, 0) AS late_hits FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.lang = b.lang ORDER BY COALESCE(a.c1, 0) + COALESCE(b.c2, 0) DESC, lang_key LIMIT 30
queries.description: Compares hit counts per browser language between the first and the last week of July with a full outer join.

queries.sql: SELECT day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS user_days FROM (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_of_month FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) INTERSECT SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_of_month FROM hits WHERE Referer = '' GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) t GROUP BY day_of_month ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Counts, per day, the users who arrived both from a search engine and directly without a referer on the same day.

queries.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(OriginalURL, 1, 5) AS original_proto, SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 5) AS final_proto, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN OriginalURL = URL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical_urls FROM hits WHERE OriginalURL LIKE 'http%' AND URL LIKE 'http%' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(OriginalURL, 1, 5), SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 5) ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, original_proto, final_proto
queries.description: Compares the protocol prefix of the original URL with that of the final URL to detect protocol switches or rewritten landing pages.

queries.sql: SELECT HitColor, ResolutionHeight, users FROM (SELECT HitColor, ResolutionHeight, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HitColor ORDER BY users DESC, ResolutionHeight) AS rn FROM (SELECT HitColor, ResolutionHeight, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE ResolutionHeight > 0 GROUP BY HitColor, ResolutionHeight) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY HitColor, rn
queries.description: For each hit color, the three screen heights used by the most users.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, SearchEngineID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_search FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, SearchEngineID), last_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(EventDate) AS last_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT s.SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS searchers, SUM(CASE WHEN l.last_day > s.first_search THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS came_back, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.last_day > s.first_search THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS came_back_share FROM s LEFT JOIN last_seen l ON l.UserID = s.UserID GROUP BY s.SearchEngineID ORDER BY searchers DESC, s.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
queries.description: For each search engine, how many of its searchers returned on a later day than their first search.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterClass, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged, SUM(IsLink) AS link_hits FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) >= 3) GROUP BY CounterClass ORDER BY CounterClass
queries.description: Traffic and engagement by counter class for heavy searchers who used at least three distinct search phrases.

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_searchers FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-10' GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate > '2013-07-10' GROUP BY UserID) t ORDER BY churned_searchers
queries.description: Counts users who ran a search before July 11 and never appeared again afterwards.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMTerm LIKE '% %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS multiword, CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(UTMTerm)) AS term_len, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMTerm) AS distinct_terms FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN UTMTerm LIKE '% %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(UTMTerm)) ORDER BY multiword, term_len LIMIT 60
queries.description: Shows the distribution of trimmed UTM term lengths, split by whether the term contains a space.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterClass, RefererRegionID, users, rn FROM (SELECT CounterClass, RefererRegionID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterClass ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, RefererRegionID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE Referer <> '' GROUP BY CounterClass, RefererRegionID) t WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY CounterClass, rn
queries.description: Top five referring regions by distinct referred users within each counter class.

queries.sql: SELECT IsNotBounce, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits WHERE ClientIP IN (SELECT ClientIP FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 20) GROUP BY IsNotBounce ORDER BY IsNotBounce
queries.description: Bounce behaviour of traffic coming from heavily shared IP addresses used by at least 20 distinct users.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN HTTPError <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN URLRegionID = RegionID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS local_landing_hits FROM hits WHERE RegionID = (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
queries.description: Hour-of-day profile of hits, HTTP errors and same-region landings for the busiest visitor region.

queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)), r AS (SELECT EventDate, hr, hits_cnt, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate) AS day_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, hr) AS rn FROM h) SELECT EventDate, hr, hits_cnt, day_hits, CAST(hits_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(day_hits, 0) AS peak_share FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: For each day, finds the peak hour and the share of that day's traffic that it carries.

queries.sql: SELECT Age, hits_cnt, headless_hits, headless_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY headless_share DESC) AS share_rank FROM (SELECT Age, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 OR CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS headless_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 OR CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS headless_share FROM hits GROUP BY Age HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) t ORDER BY share_rank, Age LIMIT 50
queries.description: Ranks age values by the share of hits from clients without JavaScript or cookies, a headless-browser signal.

queries.sql: SELECT segment, users FROM (SELECT 'churned' AS segment, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID) a UNION ALL SELECT 'newcomer' AS segment, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID) b UNION ALL SELECT 'retained' AS segment, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID INTERSECT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID) c) u ORDER BY segment
queries.description: Counts of churned, newly appearing and retained users between the first and second half of July.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Params) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Params) <= 20 THEN 1 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Params) <= 100 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS params_len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urls_with_query, SUM(CASE WHEN Params LIKE '%=%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS params_with_kv, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 5) = 'https' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS https_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Params) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Params) <= 20 THEN 1 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Params) <= 100 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ORDER BY params_len_bucket
queries.description: Hits bucketed by the character length of Params, showing how often URLs carry query strings or HTTPS and how often Params look like key=value pairs.

queries.sql: SELECT FlashMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS one_day_users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE UserID NOT IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) > 1) GROUP BY FlashMajor ORDER BY one_day_users DESC, FlashMajor LIMIT 20
queries.description: Flash major version distribution among users who never returned after their single active day.

queries.sql: SELECT ClientTimeZone, RemoteIP, users, hits_cnt, rnk FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, RemoteIP, users, hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY users DESC, hits_cnt DESC, RemoteIP) AS rnk FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, RemoteIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE RemoteIP <> 0 GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, RemoteIP) a) r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY ClientTimeZone, rnk LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each client time zone, lists the three remote IPs shared by the most distinct users, which are candidate proxies or bot farms.

translations.q001: WITH ordered AS (SELECT UserID, RefererCategoryID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID, RefererCategoryID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31'), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, RefererCategoryID AS first_category FROM ordered WHERE rn = 1), activity AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS total_hits FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_category AS first_category, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(a.active_days) AS avg_active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS return_rate FROM first_touch f JOIN activity a ON f.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY f.first_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY users DESC, first_category LIMIT 25  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q002: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 100), rd AS (SELECT RegionID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY RegionID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) SELECT RegionID, d, hits, region_avg, CAST(hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / region_avg AS spike_ratio FROM (SELECT r.RegionID, r.d, r.hits, (SELECT AVG(CAST(r2.hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM rd r2 WHERE r2.RegionID = r.RegionID) AS region_avg FROM rd r) x WHERE hits > region_avg ORDER BY spike_ratio DESC, RegionID, d LIMIT 30  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q003: WITH early AS (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY IPNetworkID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT IPNetworkID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-29') SELECT h.IPNetworkID, COUNT(*) AS early_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS early_users, COUNT(DISTINCT h.EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND h.IPNetworkID IN (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM early) GROUP BY h.IPNetworkID ORDER BY early_hits DESC, h.IPNetworkID LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q004: WITH ranked AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits), firsts AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID AS first_source FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), act AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_source AS source_id, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(a.active_days), 3) AS avg_active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users FROM firsts f JOIN act a ON f.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY f.first_source ORDER BY users DESC, source_id  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q005: SELECT kind, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT 'self_referred' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND h.Referer <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits p WHERE p.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND p.UserID = h.UserID AND p.URLHash = h.RefererHash) UNION ALL SELECT 'outside_entry' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND h.Referer <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits p WHERE p.EventDate = '2013-07-15' AND p.UserID = h.UserID AND p.URLHash = h.RefererHash)) t ORDER BY kind  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q006: SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) x) ORDER BY day_of_month  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q007: SELECT campaign_prefix, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMTerm) AS distinct_terms, AVG(lengthUTF8(UTMCampaign)) AS avg_campaign_chars FROM (SELECT UserID, UTMTerm, UTMCampaign, CASE WHEN UTMCampaign = '' THEN '(none)' ELSE substringUTF8(UTMCampaign, 1, 4) END AS campaign_prefix FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0) c GROUP BY campaign_prefix HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 2 ORDER BY users DESC, campaign_prefix LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q008: SELECT week_start_day, URLRegionID, users, rnk FROM (SELECT week_start_day, URLRegionID, users, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY week_start_day ORDER BY users DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('week', EventDate)) AS week_start_day, URLRegionID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('week', EventDate)), URLRegionID) a) t WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY week_start_day, rnk, URLRegionID LIMIT 100  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q009: WITH burners AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08'), per_user AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM burners) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN hits_cnt = 1 THEN '1' WHEN hits_cnt <= 10 THEN '2-10' WHEN hits_cnt <= 100 THEN '11-100' ELSE '101+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_total FROM per_user GROUP BY CASE WHEN hits_cnt = 1 THEN '1' WHEN hits_cnt <= 10 THEN '2-10' WHEN hits_cnt <= 100 THEN '11-100' ELSE '101+' END ORDER BY MIN(hits_cnt), bucket  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q010: WITH reg AS (SELECT RegionID AS region, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000), soc AS (SELECT RegionID AS s_region, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS social_users FROM hits WHERE SocialSourceNetworkID <> 0 GROUP BY RegionID) SELECT r.region AS region_id, r.n_hits AS total_hits, r.users AS total_users FROM reg r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc s WHERE s.s_region = r.region AND s.social_users >= 5) ORDER BY total_hits DESC, region_id LIMIT 25  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q011: WITH lang AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang_code, COUNT(*) AS total_hits FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY total_hits DESC, lang_code LIMIT 10), daily AS (SELECT h.BrowserLanguage AS lang_code, h.EventDate AS day_date, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits h INNER JOIN lang l ON h.BrowserLanguage = l.lang_code GROUP BY h.BrowserLanguage, h.EventDate), ranked AS (SELECT lang_code, day_date, day_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lang_code ORDER BY day_hits, day_date) AS rn_low, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lang_code) AS active_days, MAX(day_hits) OVER (PARTITION BY lang_code) AS peak_day_hits FROM daily) SELECT r.lang_code, r.day_date AS quietest_day, r.day_hits AS quietest_hits, r.peak_day_hits, r.active_days, l.total_hits FROM ranked r INNER JOIN lang l ON r.lang_code = l.lang_code WHERE r.rn_low = 1 ORDER BY l.total_hits DESC, r.lang_code  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q012: SELECT MobilePhoneModel, lengthUTF8(MobilePhoneModel) AS model_len FROM (SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' AND EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel EXCEPT SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel) x ORDER BY model_len, MobilePhoneModel LIMIT 50  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q013: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), fs AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM ud GROUP BY UserID) SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) AS cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.UserID) AS cohort_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM ud.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS returned_week1, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM ud.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT fs.UserID) AS retention_week1 FROM fs JOIN ud ON fs.UserID = ud.UserID WHERE fs.first_day <= '2013-07-24' GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) ORDER BY cohort_day  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q014: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RefererRegionID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY RefererRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RefererRegionID LIMIT 5), phrase_stats AS (SELECT RefererRegionID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND RefererRegionID IN (SELECT RefererRegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY RefererRegionID, SearchPhrase), ranked AS (SELECT RefererRegionID, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererRegionID ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM phrase_stats) SELECT RefererRegionID, rn, SearchPhrase, users FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY RefererRegionID, rn  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q015: WITH w1 AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID), w4 AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31' GROUP BY UserID), both_weeks AS (SELECT UserID FROM w1 INTERSECT SELECT UserID FROM w4) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w1) AS week1_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_weeks) AS retained_users, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_weeks) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w1), 0) AS retention_rate ORDER BY week1_users  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q016: WITH rd AS (SELECT RegionID AS region, EventDate AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 20) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.dt) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS spiking_regions, SUM(o.dau) AS users_in_spikes FROM rd o WHERE o.dau > 1.5 * (SELECT AVG(i.dau) FROM rd i WHERE i.region = o.region) GROUP BY o.dt ORDER BY day_of_month  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q017: SELECT start_hour, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, hr AS start_hour, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) = 1 OR secs - LAG(secs) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start FROM (SELECT UserID, EventTime, WatchID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS secs FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15') b) s WHERE is_start = 1 GROUP BY start_hour ORDER BY start_hour  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q018: WITH ud AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits), fu AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(d) AS first_d FROM ud GROUP BY UserID), cm AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(f.first_d - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS cohort_week, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(u.d - f.first_d AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS weeks_since_first, COUNT(DISTINCT u.UserID) AS users FROM ud u JOIN fu f ON u.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(f.first_d - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER), CAST(FLOOR(CAST(u.d - f.first_d AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER)) SELECT cohort_week, weeks_since_first, users, CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(MAX(users) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_week), 0) AS retention FROM cm ORDER BY cohort_week, weeks_since_first  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
